description:
As the CRM administrator, you need to set up standardized lost reasons so the sales team can accurately track why opportunities are lost.

Navigate to CRM > Configuration > Lost Reasons and create the following three new lost reasons:

1. "Chose a Competitor"
2. "Project Cancelled"
3. "Decision Maker Left Company"

Each reason should be created as a separate entry in the Lost Reasons configuration. After creating all three, they should be visible in the Lost Reasons list.

Note: There may already be some default lost reasons in the system (e.g., "Too expensive"). Do not modify or delete existing ones — only add the three new reasons listed above. The names must match exactly as specified.
